notation: Each vector gives the stored cursor before the read, the new read, other relevant LocalVars, and the expected result. dt is elapsed sim seconds for that update where relevant to the continuous wear formula.

vectors.the_trap: burnSource null WITH a burnL present is labelled 'logger'. With no rung named the book takes a present burnL as the logger's, because that is the only rung that can produce one without the aeroplane's own figures. rounding: Round half-up on the exact decimal value, to the cent, once per posting line, NET FIRST: the normalised fraction applies to the net, the net is rounded, VAT is computed off the rounded net and rounded, and gross is the sum. Never toFixed, never Math.round on a float, never price_gross x fraction. Stated in full in PRICES_AND_BILLING_RULES.json -> rounding. Every figure below is computed that way, in Python Decimal, not float.
